To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a 12-week NEMEX-TJ combined with two sessions PNE is superior to two sessions of PNO alone in reducing chronic pain and improving physical performances in patients with chronic knee pain after primary TJA.
a combined intervention of neuromuscular training and PNE was more effective in reducing pain and improving physical performances compared with PNE alone at short- and long-term follow-up.

the addition of NEuroMuscular EXercising (NEMEX) training to pain neuroscience education ( PNE ) in patients with chronic knee pain after total knee arthroscopy ( TKA ) did not result in greater pain relief and improved function compared with PNE alone.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how we can improve the treatment of patients with chronic knee pain after TKA and thereby improve their quality of life.
the development of new methods and techniques to help people with knee osteoar-thritis.
understanding how the nervous system controls movement and how the nervous system can be used as a target in rehabilitation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the study protocol is well designed, the methods are appropriate and rigorous, and the study will provide important information about the effectiveness of exercise and pain neuroscience for chronic pain after primary knee arthroplasties.
this study is the first RCT to investigate the effect of NEMEX-TJ in patients with chronic knee pain after primary TJA.

the NEMEX-TJRTJR is a randomized controlled trial investigating whether a 12 week NEuroMuscular EXerise training program combined with Pain Neuroscience Education provides greater pain relief, and improvement in physical performance than Pain Neuroscience Education alone at 12 months follow-up in a patient population with moderate-to-sever chronic pain after primary Total Knee Arthroplasty.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel exercise program (NEMEX-TJR).
the NEPNE randomized clinical trial is a study of the effect of neuromuscular exercises combined with pain neuroscience educations in patients with chronic knee pain after total knee arthro-plasties.
the NEMEX-TJr program in combination with PNE is a safe, effective and cost-effective treatment option for patients with persistent pain after total knee arthroscopy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a new treatment program that is based on the latest scientific evidence and is designed to help people with chronic pain after TJA.

pain neuroscience education (a) can be delivered to patients with knee osteoar-thritis in a group-based format with good patient satisfaction and (b) has a positive effect on pain and disability in this population, even when combined with a neuromuscular training program.
we have developed a new and effective exercise program for chronic pain after total knee arthroscopy.
